notes: Evaluates /cadence-onboard consolidated setup workflow: adopt-cadence.sh provisioning + --linked link-sdlc.sh --replace + doctor.sh verification and /cadence-interview gating.

evals.name: adopt-and-link-framework-into-fresh-repo
evals.prompt: Run /cadence-onboard <repo> --linked against a fresh git repository.
evals.expected_output: Runs adopt-cadence.sh to seed CADENCE adopter artifacts, runs link-sdlc.sh --replace so .agents/ and .gemini/ link cleanly to SDLC core, runs doctor.sh --root <repo>, and reports valid runtime symlinks plus remaining /cadence-interview placeholders.
assertions: Delegates copy setup to adopt-cadence.sh rather than manual file copying
Applies --linked via import/link-sdlc.sh --replace creating valid .agents and .gemini symlinks
Runs doctor.sh read-only verification and surfaces remaining CADENCE_ORG.md placeholders

evals.name: skip-interview-and-doctor-offload-contract
evals.expected_output: Runs adopt-cadence.sh cleanly, skips interactive prompts cleanly under --skip-interview, runs doctor.sh --check-offload, routes verbose output through offload_log_triage, and points to /cadence-define after completing /cadence-interview.
assertions: Routes doctor verification via --check-offload and offload_log_triage on :11434
